bagPolicy.summary: Regular-size purses and diaper bags are allowed. Backpacks are not allowed, and all bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: The FAQ gives no numeric size limit. Confiscated items are not returned.

parking.note: Fans can pre-book parking through ParkWhiz for convenience. Additional street parking is available on Free Street, Center Street, and Spring Street, with the Spring Street Parking Garage charging $4/hr. Availability and rates may vary depending on the event.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Cross Insurance Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Concessions are available around the concourse. Most stands are cashless. Cash is accepted only at the stands in Sections M and O.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating with adjacent companion seats is in Sections C, E, G, N, T, V, and X, and floor locations vary by event. You can buy up to three companion seats in the same row next to the accessible seat, subject to availability. Folding chairs in these areas are removed to make room for wheelchairs or scooters.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed unless the event states otherwise.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets use mobile SafeTix. Screenshots and printouts do not work. If you have no mobile device, call the box office at 207-775-3458 in advance to arrange event-day will call. Bring valid photo ID.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrances include the Unum Entrance on Free St. and the Cross Insurance Entrance at the corner of Center St. and Spring St., and each has an elevator nearby for concourse access.
